glyphs.label: WebCrypto
glyphs.description: SubtleCrypto lives in the browser — a chrome window with a small key signals Web API crypto (genkey, digest, AEAD, KDF, …).

glyphs.label: OpenPGP
glyphs.description: ModernPGP convention for encrypted mail/messages — flap envelope with lock-shackle (gpg.encrypt, gpg.sign, …).

glyphs.label: Encoding
glyphs.description: Bytes ↔ text transforms (pem, base64, hex, …) — folded rails with encode/decode arrowheads.

glyphs.label: Input / output
glyphs.description: Runtime ports and tiles (input, out, random, qr) — a simple content panel.

glyphs.label: Flow
glyphs.description: Pipeline control (foreach, tee, in, as) — two L-shaped forks suggesting stem/branch flow.

glyphs.label: Agent
glyphs.description: My Keys vault agent (unlock, save, list) — classic key plus a circular timer/TTL arc, distinct from bare Keys.

glyphs.label: HKP
glyphs.description: HTTP Keyserver Protocol lookup/search — a central node with compass spokes (directory + fetch).

glyphs.label: SSS / BLIP39
glyphs.description: Shamir secret sharing / BLIP39 — offset stacked cards as K-of-N fragments (any threshold recovers; a single share is useless alone).

glyphs.label: WebAuthn
glyphs.description: Official passkey layout: person on the left, simplified key on the right slightly overlapping (create, prf, caps).
refs: FIDO Alliance Passkey Icon Usage Guidelines

glyphs.label: Keys
glyphs.description: WebCrypto key material — genkey, export, import.

glyphs.label: Digest
glyphs.metaphor: Input lines collapsing into hash bars
glyphs.description: Cryptographic hash — long input lines beside a “#”-like pair of bars (digest).

glyphs.label: Sign
glyphs.description: Digital signature — a pen tip stroke (WebCrypto sign/verify or OpenPGP gpgsign shelf).

glyphs.label: AEAD
glyphs.description: Authenticated encryption (AES-GCM) — protective shield.

glyphs.label: Cipher
glyphs.description: Unauthenticated block/stream ciphers (AES-CBC/CTR) — four cells with a swap diagonal (not an “eye”).

glyphs.label: RSA
glyphs.description: RSA-OAEP / PKCS1 ops — document lines plus a small key.

glyphs.label: KDF
glyphs.description: HKDF/PBKDF2 — narrow extract phase then widen expand (RFC 5869 extract-then-expand).

glyphs.label: Agreement
glyphs.description: ECDH / X25519 — two key heads meeting at a shared vertical (shared secret).

glyphs.label: Wrap
glyphs.description: Key wrap / unwrap — 3D parcel with ribbon crease.

glyphs.label: Public key
glyphs.description: OpenPGP public-key ops (genkey, encrypt, inspect) — message envelope under a head.

glyphs.label: Password
glyphs.description: Symmetric OpenPGP password/SKESK shelf — key bow and bit.

glyphs.label: Split
glyphs.description: SSS split / BLIP39 encode — energy splitting into branches.

glyphs.label: Combine
glyphs.description: SSS combine — signal converging toward recovery, with a small refresh corner.

glyphs.label: Binary
glyphs.description: Binary encodings (pem, base64, hex, …) — a 2×2 bit grid.

glyphs.label: Text
glyphs.description: Text encodings (utf8) — a capital T with baseline marks.

glyphs.label: Ports
glyphs.description: I/O ports — two sockets with a bridge (input/out/random).

glyphs.label: Control
glyphs.description: Flow control shelf — three nodes linked by a U-shaped bus.

glyphs.label: Essentials
glyphs.description: WebAuthn essentials (caps, create, prf) — passkey person plus a readiness checkmark.

glyphs.label: Attestation / MDS
glyphs.description: Soft attestation / FIDO MDS — shield containing a checkmark.

glyphs.label: Directory
glyphs.description: HKP directory search — two contact silhouettes (alias of recipients).

glyphs.label: Recipients
glyphs.description: Recipients list / merge — two contact silhouettes.

glyphs.label: Variables / slots
glyphs.description: Kernel @slots chip — three cells and a plus for binding live values.

glyphs.label: Preferences
glyphs.description: Settings / preferences control.

glyphs.label: More
glyphs.description: Overflow / more menu.

glyphs.label: Keyboard shortcuts
glyphs.description: Keyboard shortcuts help — simple keyboard outline with keys.

glyphs.label: Fingerprint
glyphs.description: OpenPGP key fingerprint — ridge arcs (ModernPGP fingerprint icon).

glyphs.label: Unlock
glyphs.description: Unlock vault key into session — shackle open.

glyphs.label: Lock
glyphs.description: Lock / clear session material — shackle closed.
